description:
About Energy Exemplar

In an era where the world is rapidly advancing towards a cleaner future through decarbonization, Energy Exemplar’s mission lies in ‘Empowering Transformative Energy Decisions’. Founded in 1999 in Adelaide, Australia, our award-winning software portfolio encompassing the modeling and simulation platform PLEXOS®, Aurora, and Adapt2, is trusted by innovative organizations across the globe. Through our technology and people, we strive to enable stakeholders from across the entire energy value chain to revolutionize the energy ecosystem and to collaboratively plan and execute for a sustainable energy future with unprecedented clarity, speed, and innovation. 

Our impact is global and is being recognized across the industry. Some of our recent accolades include:

  • SaaS Company of the Year (2025) – Global Business Tech Awards.
  • Environmental Impact Award (2025) – E+E Leaders Awards.
  • IPPAI (Independent Power Producers Association of India) Power Awards (2025) - Winners
  • Finalist: Platts Global Energy Awards (2024) – Grid Edge category
  • Finalist: Reuters Global Energy Transition Awards (2024) – Technologies of Change
  • Top 50 Marketing Team (2024) – Voted by the public at the ICON Awards.

How We Work

Energy Exemplar is growing fast around 30% year on year and, that growth is driven by how we work. We trust our team to deliver great results from wherever they work best, whether that’s at home, in the office, or on the move.

We’re a global team that values ownership, integrity, and innovation. You’ll be supported to balance work and life in a way that works for you, and empowered to take initiative, solve problems, and make an impact, regardless of your background, location, or role.

Our four core values, Customer Success, One Global Team, Integrity & Ownership, and Innovation Excellence aren’t just words. They show up in how we collaborate, how we solve, and how we grow together.

About the Role

As a member of the EMEA Solutions team at Energy Exemplar, this role is the bridge between our power trading customer base and the full capability of the PLEXOS platform. The ideal candidate combines deep expertise in fundamental energy market modelling with hands-on experience in trading desk workflows, and is equally comfortable scripting automated pipelines. 

This is a unique opportunity to work closely with trading organisations across EMEA, helping them unlock the full operational potential of PLEXOS and shaping how energy trading desks leverage fundamental modelling in their day-to-day decisions. 

This role has three primary objectives: 

  1. Deliver tailored support and solutions for power trading customers and prospects: Work collaboratively with customers to ensure PLEXOS meets the needs of trading desks, from pre-trade analysis to post-trade optimisation. 
  2. Pre-Sales Technical Support: Partner with the EMEA sales team to demonstrate the value of PLEXOS to prospective trading organisations. Responsibilities include delivering technical demonstrations tailored to trading desk use cases, responding to detailed functional and technical queries during the sales process, supporting proof-of-concept engagements, and contributing to thought leadership content that positions Energy Exemplar as the platform of choice for fundamental-model-driven trading. 
  3. Post-Sales Customer Success: Serve as a trusted technical point of contact for existing trading customers. Support onboarding, resolve modelling and workflow challenges, and work collaboratively with customers to ensure their PLEXOS deployment continues to meet the evolving needs of their trading operations. Act as the voice of the trading customer back into the Solutions team, surfacing recurring needs and improvement opportunities. 

Key Skills and Expertise 

The ideal candidate will have a background similar to a trading analyst, with practical experience in: 

  • Working with fundamental (stack) market models to forecast power prices, cross-border flows, and supply-demand dynamics across short-, medium-, and long-term horizons. 
  • Familiarity with trading desk operations and the tempo of intraday and day-ahead markets  
  • Strong scripting skills (Python or similar) for automation and workflow integration  
  • Comfort working with APIs, CLI tools, and cloud-based computation environmentsApplying market models to support pre-trade decisions, including physical energy trading and proprietary trading. 
  • Understanding how trading desks use modelling outputs to optimise market positions, assess risk, and identify arbitrage opportunities. 
  • Using modelling to evaluate Value at Risk (VaR), inform hedging strategies, and optimise portfolio performance. 
  • Supporting strategies for participation in secondary markets (Balancing Markets, Ancillary Services, Capacity Markets, etc.). 
  • Analysing the impact of market disruptions, policy changes, and new technologies on trading strategies. 

 

Key Responsibilities 

  • Customer Engagement and Model Delivery 
  • Act as a trusted advisor to power trading customers, helping them build and refine models that directly support trading decisions. 
  • Lead requirements gathering sessions with trading teams to understand business goals and decision-making workflows. 
  • Design and implement innovative modelling approaches using PLEXOS, tailored to trading-specific needs such as price forecasting, congestion analysis, and dispatch optimisation. 
  • Provide guidance on industry best practices for market modelling in trading contexts. 
  • Analyse modelling outputs with customers to ensure they align with trader expectations and market observations, recommending adjustments to data or assumptions as needed. 
  • Develop, test, and calibrate models to deliver accurate and actionable insights for trading desks. 
  • Train trading teams to effectively use PLEXOS for decision support and strategy development. 
  • Business Development and Thought Leadership 
  • Partner with the sales team to engage with prospective trading customers, demonstrating how PLEXOS can address their specific challenges and enhance trading operations. 
  • Create Proof of Concept (PoC) studies that showcase the value of PLEXOS for pre-trade analysis, risk management, and portfolio optimisation. 
  • Deliver tailored presentations, technical demonstrations, and training sessions for trading-focused audiences. 
  • Collaborate with the product team to provide feedback on market needs and contribute to enhancements in PLEXOS for trading applications. 
  • Conduct market research and provide thought leadership on emerging trends in power trading, generating insights that can be shared with customers and at industry events. 
  • Develop original studies on power trading topics, starting with Energy Exemplar's simulation-ready datasets, and present findings in webinars and conferences. 

This is a customer facing role, and therefore successful candidates will not only have strong modelling capabilities and domain expertise, but also have excellent communication skills, be outgoing, professional, driven and able to multi-task in a dynamic and often changing environment. 

Our customers use our products to help shape the future of the energy industry, and as such this role offers the opportunity to work with cutting edge technologies, collaborate with key players in energy markets, and solve the most fundamental problems facing the energy sector today.  

The role can be based out of our London office, or remote working. The role also offers the opportunity for international travel across the Europe, Middle East and Africa regions.

description: ABOUT FLOCK Road accidents kill and injure people, damage vehicles, and cost businesses fortunes. But traditional insurance does nothing to prevent them - it just pays out claims when they happen. At Flock, we’re changing that. Using telematics, AI, and real-time data, we proactively help our fleet customers prevent crashes. We obsessively focus on keeping drivers safe, and we put our money where our mouth is - paying out millions of pounds per year to fleets that get safer over time. We were acquired by Admiral in May 2026. Now we combine the backing of the UK’s leading motor insurer with startup energy and speed. We’re growing fast with bigger plans than ever, and we’re hugely optimistic that our approach will save many more lives in the decade ahead. We’re on a mission to make the world quantifiably safer. Join us! We’re an AI-first business, so whatever the role, we want people who reach for AI by default, stay curious about what it can do, and use it to work faster and think bigger. THE ROLE At Flock, we’re transforming the motor fleet insurance landscape with cutting-edge technology and data-driven insights. As a Senior Motor Fleet Underwriter, you’ll play a pivotal role in our mission to deliver smarter, safer, and more cost-effective insurance solutions. You’ll leverage advanced analytics and AI to assess risk, optimise underwriting processes, and create tailored policies that meet the unique needs of our clients. Your expertise will drive our growth, helping us build a future where innovation and excellence in insurance are the norm. If you’re passionate about making an impact, thrive in a dynamic startup environment, and are ready to lead the charge in redefining fleet insurance, we want you on our team! WHAT WE THINK IS MOST EXCITING ABOUT THE ROLE: You’ll have the autonomy to manage and develop a large business portfolio, mentor junior team members, and significantly contribute to team targets. You’ll help unlock growth into new market segments, offering insurance solutions for emerging mobility trends, and support our ambition to become one of the UK’s largest fleet MGAs. Your expertise will drive growth and innovation, positioning us at the forefront of the fleet insurance industry. You’ll also work with AI in the underwriting process itself, using it to pull risk data out of submissions and triage cases faster, which leaves your time for the judgement calls that need an experienced underwriter. WHAT YOU’LL BRING TO FLOCK ESSENTIAL Extensive experience underwriting motor fleet insurance Track record of building strong and supportive relationships with insurance brokers The ability to collate data and provide support to our Head of Underwriting to enable them to monitor and analyse the portfolio Provide feedback and continuously improve the process for gathering risk information from our clients, in order to ensure frictionless quoting and onboarding for all clients and brokers Identify and surface to our Underwriting Manager areas where we can improve our policy wording and coverage Follow rapidly evolving market trends, continuously refurbishing your knowledge of cutting-edge products and services in the Motor Fleet Actively train and develop members of the Underwriting and operations teams and to help promote Underwriting knowledge across Flock Comfortable using AI in underwriting work, for example extracting and checking risk information or speeding up quoting, while keeping your own judgement on every decision PREFERABLE Experience in dealing with large corporate customers ACII qualified or working towards Experience of working closely with product teams to ensure product, process and customer journey enhancements are included within the product roadmap WHAT WE OFFER (in addition to a competitive salary) 25 days of holiday (+ Bank Holidays) 🏖 Share Incentive Plan 📈 Workplace Pension 💰 Private Medical Insurance 🏥 (including Dental 🦷 Optical 👓 & Mental Health 💆‍♀️ support options) Various Salary Sacrifice Schemes - Holiday Purchase, Tech, Gym, Cycle to Work, Electric Vehicle, Private Medical Insurance for families 💵 Enhanced Parental Leave and Pay 🐣 £1000 toward relevant professional qualifications 🎓 £500 per annum towards learning and development 🌱 3 days paid leave for L&D purposes 🌻 At Flock, we typically follow a hybrid working model involving a minimum of 3 days per week spent in the office, which is based in Central London, a few minutes walk from Moorgate and Liverpool Street. Please note if your role involves visit to client sites and broker offices, then this can be substituted for office days. ONE LAST THING.. Authenticity is important to us. We value the unique qualities and experiences you bring. So if you apply, just be your genuine self. It’s who we want! Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: About us At Trainline, our purpose is to empower greener travel choices, connecting people and places. Trainline enables millions of travellers to find and book the best value tickets across carriers, fares, and journey options through our highly rated mobile app, website, and B2B partner channels. Great journeys start with Trainline 🚄 We’re Europe’s leading independent rail platform, helping millions of travellers find and book the best-value rail and coach journeys across our app, website and partner channels. Our job is to make the green travel choice the best choice. By building a better train travel experience, we help more people choose rail - creating a positive impact for customers, our business and the planet. We’re a team of more than 1,000 Trainliners from over 50 nationalities, working across London, Paris, Barcelona, Milan, Edinburgh and Madrid. Now is a brilliant time to join us and help shape the future of travel. Introducing the Trainline Finance Team 👋 At Trainline, our Finance team is the backbone of how we manage, govern, and grow the business responsibly. From transactional processing to financial controls and systems ownership, the team works across a broad range of disciplines to ensure Trainline operates with accuracy, integrity, and commercial rigour. This is a pivotal interim appointment within our operational finance function, sitting within a high-performing team and reporting directly to the Group Financial Controller. As Interim Senior Operational Finance Manager, you will lead the teams responsible for Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Finance Systems, and our Cashbook function, driving operational excellence and embedding a continuous improvement mindset across the function. You will work closely with Finance leadership and Technology colleagues to strengthen controls, streamline processes, and maintain delivery momentum throughout a six-month fixed-term engagement, with a clear and structured handover at its close. In this role as the Interim Senior Operational Finance Manager, you will...🚄 Lead and develop a multi-disciplinary operational finance team across Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Finance Systems, and Cashbook, setting clear objectives, managing team capacity, and actively supporting the professional growth of every team member. Own the day-to-day management of the AP and AR functions, ensuring invoices, payments, collections, and reconciliations are processed accurately, on time, and in line with strong governance and compliance standards. Drive working capital performance by monitoring AP and AR KPIs, proactively managing aged debt and debtor days, and delivering regular reporting and insight to the Group Financial Controller. Oversee bank and cash reconciliation across all entities and currencies, maintaining robust controls over cash processes including payment authorisation, segregation of duties, and reconciliation review. Act as business owner for Trainline's core finance systems, ensuring platforms are scalable, secure, and well-governed, and that teams are empowered to use them effectively through training and change management. Own the operational finance contribution to month-end close, ensuring ledgers are closed accurately and on time, and serve as a key point of contact throughout internal and external audit processes. Identify and deliver process improvements with a focus on automation, efficiency, and scalability, coordinating with the Senior Finance Manager - Transformation to ensure changes are aligned with the broader Finance transformation roadmap. Build trusted relationships across Finance, Technology, and the wider business, acting as the senior point of contact for operational finance and managing SLAs with internal stakeholders. We'd love to hear from you if you have...🔍 Substantial experience managing operational finance functions, ideally spanning Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, and finance systems in a fast-paced commercial environment. A strong track record of leading and developing high-performing finance teams, with the ability to set direction, manage performance, and support the professional growth of team members. Solid expertise across AP/AR processes, credit control, working capital management, and financial controls, with a high standard of attention to detail and data governance. Experience working within an ERP environment, ideally Microsoft Dynamics 365 or a comparable platform, with a confident grasp of transactional finance processes end-to-end. A process improvement mindset, with demonstrated success delivering automation and efficiency gains across operational finance functions. Strong communication skills and the ability to build effective working relationships with stakeholders across Finance, Technology, and senior business leadership. Confidence managing SLAs and service expectations with internal stakeholders, alongside the resilience to operate effectively in a fast-paced and evolving environment. Availability at short notice and comfort operating in an interim capacity, with the drive to take ownership quickly, deliver impact within a defined timeframe, and lead a clear and structured handover. More information: Enjoy fantastic perks like private healthcare & dental insurance, a generous work from abroad policy, 2-for-1 share purchase plans, an EV Scheme to further reduce carbon emissions, extra festive time off, and excellent family-friendly benefits. We prioritise career growth with clear career paths, transparent pay bands, personal learning budgets, and regular learning days. Jump on board and supercharge your career from day one! We're operating a hybrid model and ask that Trainliners work from the office a minimum of 60% of their time over a 12-week period. We also have a 28-day Work from Abroad policy. Our values represent the things that matter most to us and what we live and breathe everyday, in everything we do: 💭 Think Big - We're building the future of rail ✔️ Own It - We focus on every customer, partner and journey 🤝 Travel Together - We're one team ♻️ Do Good - We make a positive impact We know that having a diverse team makes us better and helps us succeed. And we mean all forms of diversity - gender, ethnicity, sexuality, disability, nationality and diversity of thought. That's why we're committed to creating inclusive places to work, where everyone belongs and differences are valued and celebrated. Interested in finding out more about what it's like to work at Trainline? Why not check us out on LinkedIn, Instagram and Glassdoor! description: Deine Karrierechance (ab 01.10.2026) Du willst als Senior Partnerships Manager ein starkes Partner-Ökosystem aufbauen, strategische Kooperationen vorantreiben und HERO bei relevanten Partnern, Marken und Multiplikator*innen sichtbar machen? Du suchst eine Rolle, in der Du remote innerhalb Deutschlands arbeiten kannst, gleichzeitig hybrid aus Hannover oder Berlin andocken kannst und mit Reisetätigkeit auf Messen, Events und in Netzwerken genau dort bist, wo starke Partnerschaften entstehen? Dann ist dies die passende Stelle für Dich! Deine Mission Du baust unser Partnership-Ökosystem aktiv aus und identifizierst strategisch relevante Partner, statt nur eingehende Anfragen zu verwalten. Du verantwortest unsere zentralen Partner-Channels end-to-end – von HERO Business Partners über Brand Partnerships bis hin zu Reference Partners. Du entwickelst skalierbare Partnership-Formate, zum Beispiel Co-Events, Messe-Kooperationen und weitere Aktivierungsformate. Du qualifizierst neue Anfragen strukturiert, priorisierst klar und entwickelst bestehende Partnerschaften gezielt weiter. Du repräsentierst HERO auf Messen, Events und in relevanten Netzwerken, baust aktiv neue Kontakte auf und entwickelst daraus starke Partnerschaften. Du arbeitest eng mit internen Stakeholdern und dem Events-Umfeld zusammen, um passende Formate, Partnerkonstellationen und Aktivierungen zu definieren. Du misst den Erfolg Deiner Partnership-Formate anhand von Leads, Reichweite und ROI und leitest daraus konkrete Empfehlungen für den weiteren Ausbau ab. Requirements Deine Superkräfte Du bringst mehrjährige Erfahrung im Aufbau und in der Weiterentwicklung von Partnerschaften, Kooperationen oder strategischen Business-Relationships mit. Du arbeitest strukturiert, eigenverantwortlich und priorisierst sicher zwischen Opportunitäten, laufenden Initiativen und langfristigem Potenzial. Du fühlst Dich in der aktiven Ansprache externer Partner wohl und überzeugst mit einem souveränen, verbindlichen Auftreten. Du gehst offen auf Menschen zu, bewegst Dich sicher in Netzwerk- und Eventkontexten und baust belastbare Beziehungen zu relevanten Partnern auf. Du denkst strategisch, setzt aber genauso gerne operativ um und bringst Themen eigenständig ins Rollen. Du kannst Partnerschaften nicht nur anstoßen, sondern auch in skalierbare Formate und belastbare Prozesse übersetzen. Du hast ein gutes Gespür für Marke, Botschaften und eine saubere Umsetzung an allen Kontaktpunkten mit externen Partnern. Du arbeitest gern cross-funktional mit Teams aus Marketing, Sales, Product und weiteren Stakeholdern zusammen. Du denkst datenbasiert und kannst Ergebnisse, Potenziale und Empfehlungen klar und verständlich aufbereiten. Du bringst die Bereitschaft zu Reisetätigkeit mit, um Partnerschaften vor Ort aufzubauen, zu vertiefen und aktiv zu networken. Hier findest Du weitere Infos und Eindrücke zu uns: Schaue Dir gerne unseren Bewerbungsprozess auf unserer Karriereseite an Verschaffe Dir anhand der Bewertungen auf unseremKununu-Profil einen noch besseren Eindruck von uns @weare_herosoftware auf Instagram und HERO Software auf LinkedIn! THE WORK:

As a Senior Staff Security Engineer focused on AI Security, you will be Ripple's deepest technical expert at the intersection of artificial intelligence and security. This is a purpose-built, high-impact individual contributor role that spans two critical mandates: securing AI systems that Ripple builds and operates, and harnessing AI to make Ripple's security function faster, smarter, and more scalable.

You will lead the technical strategy for AI security across the agentic SDLC, define and operationalize guardrails for LLM and agentic AI adoption, and build AI-powered security tooling in close partnership with the broader organization to embed AI security into how Ripple operates every day. You will also shape Ripple's external posture on AI security, contributing to industry standards, regulatory discussions, and Ripple's published security practices.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

  • Drive the AI Security technical strategy and roadmap, defining how Ripple secures its AI systems, governs agentic workflows, and embeds security controls into the AI development lifecycle from day one.
  • Design and implement security controls for LLM-integrated and agentic AI systems, including sandboxing, identity and permission scoping, runtime monitoring, and containment of autonomous agent actions that exceed authorized scope.
  • Own AI security across the Controlled Agentic SDLC, establishing security guardrails, AI provenance standards, dual-review requirements, and audit trail controls for AI-assisted development across Ripple Engineering.
  • Lead the security review and risk assessment of all AI integrations entering production, including LLM APIs, SaaS copilots, AI code editors, agentic workflows, third-party MCP servers, and vendor-embedded AI.
  • Build and scale Ripple's Shadow AI detection capability, surfacing unsanctioned AI usage, driving adoption of the AI acceptable use policy, and ensuring all AI workflows operate within Ripple's auditable perimeter.
  • Serve as Ripple's go-to technical resource on agentic AI risks, including MCP server security, tool poisoning, prompt injection at the orchestration layer, and excessive agency in multi-agent systems, translating emerging threats into concrete mitigations with Engineering and Product.
  • Shape Ripple's external AI security posture, contributing to industry frameworks, engaging regulators, and publishing research that establishes Ripple as a credible voice in responsible AI security. 

WHAT YOU'LL BRING: 

  • 10+ years of Security Engineering experience with demonstrated depth in at least two domains, such as Product Security, Cloud Security, or Security Operations, and meaningful hands-on exposure to AI or ML security in practice.
  • Solid understanding of AI and LLM security concepts, including prompt injection, jailbreaks, data poisoning, model extraction, RAG manipulation, and agentic risks such as tool poisoning, excessive agency, and MCP server vulnerabilities.
  • Experience securing agentic AI systems, including sandboxing, permission scoping, human-in-the-loop design, or runtime monitoring for autonomous workflows.
  • Fluency with core Security Engineering domains including cloud security on AWS, GCP, or Azure, CI/CD pipeline security, container and Kubernetes security, IAM, and API security, with the ability to reason about how these apply in AI-specific contexts.
  • Strong threat modeling instincts, whether using STRIDE, MITRE ATLAS, OWASP LLM Top 10, or your own approach, and comfort applying frameworks to architectures where the playbook remains in development.
  • Experience in FinTech, crypto, or other highly regulated environments is a strong plus, ideally with exposure to frameworks like NYDFS, MAS, DORA, or SOC 2 as they relate to AI adoption.
  • Proven ability to work across teams, influence technical direction without direct authority, and bring structure to problems that span Engineering, Product, and Security.
  • A genuine builder's mentality. You are energized by problems without established playbooks, comfortable building in ambiguity, and motivated by raising the bar in an area that is still being defined.

Our mission is to build a proactive smart assistant for everyday users to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal prompting. Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. The system must handle multi-step reasoning, interact with external tools, and remain reliable despite non-deterministic model behavior. Our objective is to help users complete tasks daily enjoyable with over ~90%* reduced time. Role This is a deeply technical, hands-on role. Work directly with engineers on system design, evaluation, and trade-offs-defining requirements, but shaping how the system works for global users. You work at the intersection of user needs, model capability, and system constraints, and are responsible for turning AI potential into real, reliable behavior in a real-world application. What You'll be Doing Research and define end-to-end AI system requirements from capability to behavior to user impact Translate model capabilities, data constraints, and evaluation results into clear product and system decisions Make hard trade-offs across quality, latency, cost, reliability, and UX Work closely with ML, backend, and mobile engineers on system design, evaluation, and iteration Define and evolve evaluation frameworks across offline metrics, online experiments, and human feedback Drive execution with clear specs, strong judgment, and disciplined prioritization Ensure systems ship quickly, safely, and reliably, with strong feedback loops Own product quality end-to-end - correctness, predictability, and user trust What You Will Need Technical foundation Strong grounding in computer science fundamentals, including algorithms, data structures, and system design. Solid understanding of ML fundamentals and how modern AI systems behave in production. Comfort reading, reviewing, and discussing technical design documents. AI & ML experience Hands-on exposure to AI-powered products, including LLM-based systems. Experience working with model evaluation, prompt or pipeline iteration, and feedback loops. Strong intuition for model limitations, hallucinations, bias, and drift. Product leadership Significant experience owning complex, technical products end-to-end. Proven ability to work closely with senior engineers and ML teams. Strong judgment and decision-making ability in ambiguous, fast-moving environments. Ability to balance ambition with technical and operational reality. Nice to have Experience shipping AI-heavy consumer products. Background as an engineer or highly technical product manager. Experience defining evaluation metrics for ML systems. Strong intuition for AI UX patterns and failure handling. Prior experience in zero-to-one product environments. Outcomes Product strategy clearly aligns AI capabilities with user needs and company priorities. AI features deliver real value, are understandable, predictable, and trusted by users. Decisions balance quality, speed, cost, and reliability effectively under uncertainty. Roadmaps and priorities are clear, with fast iteration based on real user feedback. Teams are aligned, focused, and able to execute on AI product goals with minimal friction. How We Work The best products today in the world were built by small, world class teams. We are a high talent density and hands-on team. We make decisions collectively, move at rapid speed, striking a balance between shipping high quality work and learning. Joining our team requires the ability to bring structure, exercise judgment, and execute independently. Our goal is to put in hands of our users a truly magical product. Interview process If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach to schedule 3, but no more than 4 interviews. Applications are evaluated by our technical team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite. We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us. description:
About Us 

SharkNinja is a global product design and technology company, with a diversified portfolio of 5-star rated lifestyle solutions that positively impact people’s lives in homes around the world. Powered by two trusted, global brands, Shark and Ninja, the company has a proven track record of bringing disruptive innovation to market and developing one consumer product after another has allowed SharkNinja to enter multiple product categories, driving significant growth and market share gains. Headquartered in Needham, Massachusetts with more than 4,100 associates, the company’s products are sold at key retailers, online and offline, and through distributors around the world. 

AI at SharkNinja

At SharkNinja, we’re building an AI-native culture. We’re not waiting for the future; we’re creating it. Our people are expected to experiment boldly, adopt new tools, and continuously raise what’s possible to create meaningful impact for our consumers. If you believe the best way to do your job hasn’t been invented yet, you’ll fit right in.

Senior UX Designer - DTC 

Leeds or London (In office 3 days/week) 

About the role 

SharkNinja is seeking a strategic, highly skilled Senior UX Designer to join our Global Digital Store Centre of Excellence. This role will be instrumental in shaping and delivering best-in-class user experiences across our global direct-to-consumer (DTC) websites. 

As a Senior UX Designer, you will combine strategic UX thinking with hands-on design craft, leading the end-to-end experience from research and insight through user flows, wireframes, prototypes and high-fidelity UI. You will help define global UX principles while ensuring experiences are grounded in customer needs, business objectives and measurable performance. 

You’ll partner closely with Product, Engineering, Creative, Marketing, CRO, Analytics and regional DTC teams to bring the SharkNinja brand to life online, continuously improving experiences through research, experimentation and data. 

This is an opportunity to help set the UX standard for a growing global ecommerce business while remaining close to the craft and measurable customer experience. 

RESPONSIBILITIES 

UX Design & Delivery 

  • Lead the end-to-end UX design process, from discovery and research through user flows, wireframes, prototypes, high-fidelity UI and final engineering handoff. 
  • Translate complex customer and business needs into intuitive, engaging and commercially effective digital experiences. 
  • Create clear user journeys, interaction models and prototypes that communicate design intent to stakeholders and engineering teams. 
  • Balance customer needs, brand expression, commercial objectives and technical constraints throughout the design process. 
  • Deliver high-quality, responsive and mobile-first experiences across SharkNinja’s global DTC ecosystem. 

Research & Customer Insight 

  • Plan and conduct user research, usability testing, customer interviews and other qualitative research to uncover customer needs and experience friction. 
  • Leverage quantitative and qualitative insight, including analytics, session replay, surveys and customer research, to inform design decisions. 
  • Synthesise research into clear insights and actionable recommendations that influence product and experience direction. 
  • Champion the voice of the customer across cross-functional teams and ensure customer needs remain central to decision-making. 
  • Validate concepts and designs throughout the development process rather than relying solely on post-launch measurement. 

CRO, Analytics & Experimentation 

  • Partner closely with CRO and Analytics teams to identify customer friction, commercial opportunities and areas for experience improvement. 
  • Develop UX solutions designed to improve conversion, engagement and customer satisfaction. 
  • Support and contribute to A/B testing and experimentation programmes, using findings to validate hypotheses and continuously improve experiences. 
  • Use quantitative and qualitative data to evaluate design performance and inform iteration. 
  • Establish clear success measures for key experience initiatives and connect design decisions to measurable customer and commercial outcomes. 

Global UX Standards & Design Systems 

  • Contribute to defining the global UX vision, principles and roadmap for SharkNinja’s DTC experiences. 
  • Establish and maintain UX best practices and processes that improve consistency, quality and efficiency. 
  • Contribute to maintaining and evolving shared design systems, patterns, style guides and Figma libraries to support global scalability and adoption. 
  • Act as a Figma expert, championing scalable component design and efficient collaborative workflows. 
  • Run design reviews and critique sessions to continually raise the quality bar across digital experiences. 

Accessibility & Inclusive Design 

  • Champion accessibility and inclusive design throughout the end-to-end design process. 
  • Ensure experiences and design-system components meet appropriate WCAG accessibility standards. 
  • Consider accessibility across interaction design, visual design, content hierarchy, responsive behavior and component development. 
  • Partner with Engineering to ensure accessibility requirements are maintained from design through implementation. 

Cross-Functional Collaboration 

  • Work closely with Product, Engineering, Creative, Marketing, Trading, CRO and Analytics teams to transform business objectives into seamless digital experiences. 
  • Partner with Engineering throughout the design process to understand technical opportunities and constraints and ensure high-quality implementation. 
  • Collaborate with regional DTC teams to understand local customer and commercial needs while maintaining global experience consistency. 
  • Communicate design rationale clearly and confidently to stakeholders, including senior leadership. 
  • Build strong partnerships across disciplines and champion a collaborative, customer-centred design culture. 

 

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE 

  • Intuitive, engaging and accessible customer experiences delivered consistently across SharkNinja’s global DTC ecosystem. 
  • Measurable improvements in conversion, engagement and customer satisfaction driven by UX design. 
  • Design decisions grounded in customer research, experimentation, analytics and data, not assumption. 
  • A mature experimentation culture where UX hypotheses are tested, measured and continuously refined. 
  • Strong collaboration between UX, Product and Engineering from discovery through implementation. 
  • Consistent, scalable and accessible global design patterns and systems. 
  • A demonstrable improvement in overall digital experience quality across markets. 

ATTRIBUTES & SKILLS 

  • 5+ years of experience in UX or Product Design, ideally within a fast-paced ecommerce or DTC environment. 
  • A strong portfolio demonstrating end-to-end UX design, from research and journey definition through wireframes, prototyping, UI and shipped digital experiences. 
  • Expert-level proficiency in Figma, including prototyping, components, libraries and design systems. 
  • Strong understanding of user research methods and experience planning and conducting research independently. 
  • Experience using analytics, CRO and experimentation to inform and evaluate design decisions. 
  • Experience designing for and contributing to A/B testing programmes. 
  • Deep understanding of interaction design, responsive design, usability and mobile-first principles. 
  • Strong understanding of accessibility standards, including WCAG, and inclusive design principles. 
  • Experience working closely with Engineering and an understanding of front-end/UI engineering principles and technical constraints. 
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate quantitative and qualitative findings into actionable design improvements. 
  • Excellent presentation, storytelling and stakeholder-management skills. 
  • Experience contributing to and evolving scalable design systems. 
  • Highly organized and comfortable managing multiple projects and shifting priorities in a fast-paced environment. 
  • Passion for continually raising the quality of customer experiences and connecting excellent design to measurable business outcomes. 

 

 

Our Culture

At SharkNinja, we don’t just raise the bar—we push past it every single day.  Our Outrageously Extraordinary mindset drives us to tackle the impossible, push boundaries, and deliver results that others only dream of. If you thrive on breaking out of your swim lane, you’ll be right at home.

What We Offer

We offer competitive health insurance, retirement plans, paid time off, employee stock purchase options, wellness programs, SharkNinja product discounts, and more. We empower your personal and professional growth with high impact Learning Programs featuring bold voices redefining what’s possible. When you join, you’re not just part of a company—you’re part of an outrageously extraordinary community. Together, we won’t just launch products—we’ll disrupt entire markets.  

At SharkNinja, Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion are vital to our global success. Valuing each unique voice and blending all of our diverse skills strengthens SharkNinja’s innovation every day. We support ALL associates in bringing their authentic selves to work, making an impact, and having the opportunity for career acceleration. With help from our leadership, associates, and our community, we aim to have equity be a key component of the SharkNinja DNA.

description:
Kurz und knapp

Suchst du eine Führungsrolle, in der deine positive Energie und dein Teamgeist den Unterschied machen?

Bei Picnic suchen wir nicht nur jemanden, der Prozesse steuert, sondern eine Führungskraft, die ihr Team inspiriert und jeden Tag zu einem Erfolgserlebnis macht. Als Teamleiter Logistik (m/w/d) bist du das Herzstück des täglichen Betriebs in unserem Fulfillment Center (FC) in Viernheim. Du coachst, motivierst und unterstützt dein Team aus Shoppers, stellst sicher, dass sie sich wohlfühlen und gemeinsam Großes leisten. Dein Engagement ist entscheidend, um unsere Lagerabläufe reibungslos zu gestalten. Im engen Austausch mit anderen Teamleitungen und der Schichtleitung sorgst du dafür, dass wir als großes Team unsere täglichen Ziele erreichen.


Das erwartet dich 

  • Teamleitung: Leite, motiviere und inspiriere täglich ein Team aus 20+ Shoppers. Du bist ihre erste Ansprechperson, hast stets ein offenes Ohr und förderst ihre Entwicklung.
  • Teamwork: Gemeinsam mit anderen Teamleitungen und der Schichtleitung steuerst du proaktiv die Prozesse im FC. Du trägst maßgeblich zu einer positiven und unterstützenden Arbeitsatmosphäre bei.
  • Tagesgeschäft: Stelle sicher, dass alle Einkäufe pünktlich, sicher und in bester Qualität das FC verlassen. Dabei bist du der Fels in der Brandung, der auch in stressigen Situationen einen kühlen Kopf bewahrt und Ruhe ausstrahlt.
  • Prozessoptimierung: Bringe deine Ideen ein und verbessere gemeinsam mit dem Leadership stetig unsere Logistikprozesse. Du ermutigst dein Team, mitzudenken und sich aktiv einzubringen.
  • Faires Gehalt mit Perspektive: Ein Jahresgehalt zwischen 34.000 € und 38.000 € brutto, bewertet durch jährliche Performance Reviews, für deine persönliche und finanzielle Weiterentwicklung.

Das bringst du mit

  • Du hast eine abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung im Bereich Logistik, Hotellerie, Gastronomie oder Ähnlichem absolviert.
  • Alternativ bringst du min. 1 Jahr Berufserfahrung in der Teamleitung oder einer ähnlichen Führungsposition in der Logistik mit.
  • Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und hast gute Englischkenntnisse, um dich in unserem internationalen Team zu verständigen.
  • Du bist flexibel für die Arbeit in zwei Schichten (6:00 – 14:30 Uhr & 14:30 – 23:00 Uhr, auch samstags) in einer 37,5-Stunden-Woche.
  • Du liebst es, mit Menschen zusammenzuarbeiten und packst selbst mit an.

Darauf kannst du dich freuen

  • Starte durch - mit uns: Werde Teil unseres internationalen Teams in einem Umfeld, das echtes Wachstum und eine „Act like an Owner“-Mentalität fördert. Bei uns hast du die Chance, neue Ideen zu testen und direkt miterleben zu können, wie deine Arbeit in unserem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen Wirkung zeigt.
  • Nachhaltigkeit als Kern: Werde Teil der Revolution. Du trägst zu einer grüneren Zukunft bei – durch unsere 100 % elektrische Flotte und eine Lieferkette, die Lebensmittelverschwendung reduziert.
  • Die Basics: Wir stellen dir alles für deinen Erfolg bereit – mit Zugang zu modernen und innovativen Tools, die dich im Arbeitsalltag optimal unterstützen, sowie exklusiven Mitarbeiter-Rabatten (Corporate Benefits) für Reisen, Technik und vieles mehr.
  • Zeit zum Auftanken: Mit 30 Urlaubstagen pro Jahr sorgst du für den perfekten Ausgleich zwischen Arbeit und Erholung.
  • Verpflegung für Gewinner: Wir kümmern uns um dich. Genieße jeden Tag ein frisches, kostenloses Frühstück, Mittag- und Abendessen in unserem Fulfilment Center, dazu gibt es reichlich Snacks und Obst für den Energiekick zwischendurch.
  • Unvergessliche Momente: Wir sind mehr als nur ein Team. Ob bei unseren Weihnachts- oder Sommerpartys und weitere Teamevents – wir feiern unsere Erfolge gemeinsam und schaffen Erinnerungen, die verbinden.
  • Lebensmittelretter: Hol dir unsere exklusiven "Too-Good-To-Go"-Tüten und rette leckere Lebensmittel – nur für unsere Mitarbeitenden!
  • Lerne & wachse: Profitiere von internen Lern- & Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten durch spannende Workshops und intensive Bootcamps, um deine Skills ständig zu erweitern.
  • Absicherung für morgen: Wir unterstützen dich mit einem überdurchschnittlichen Zuschuss zur Betrieblichen Altersvorsorge, damit du auch an später denkst.

You will work as an experienced individual contributor across USRO, moving from problem definition through analysis, workflow design, implementation, measurement, and handoff. Vogel ist eine der erfolgreichsten mittelständischen Beratungsgesellschaften in Deutschland – mehrere Tausend mittelständische Unternehmen vertrauen uns ihre Steuer-, kaufmännischen und strategischen Themen an. Wir wachsen organisch und durch Zukäufe und bauen daraus die führende Beratungsplattform für den deutschen Mittelstand. Jeder Zukauf bringt eine neue Gesellschaft, eine Eröffnungsbilanz, eine Kaufpreisallokation und einen erweiterten Konsolidierungskreis mit. Damit das trägt, braucht es jemanden, bei dem niemand mehr nachrechnet, ob der Konzernabschluss steht. Du bist bestellter Wirtschaftsprüfer oder stehst unmittelbar vor dem Examen, mit vier oder mehr Jahren Audit bei einer der großen oder der nächstgrößeren Prüfungsgesellschaften und echter Konzernabschluss-Tiefe. Du verantwortest das Rechnungswesen von Vogel – Konsolidierung und Konzernabschluss, das laufende Rechnungswesen über alle Gesellschaften, dessen Automatisierung und das externe Reporting an Banken und Stakeholder. Du berichtest direkt an Joachim und Moritz Vogel; am Standort München entsteht die Finance-Funktion gerade erst, und du bist ihr fachlicher Anker. Du führst jeden Zukauf in den Konsolidierungskreis – Eröffnungsbilanz, Kaufpreisallokation, laufende Einbindung. Dein Maßstab: Der Prozess muss den nächsten Zukauf tragen, ohne dass jemand einen Sonderlauf aufsetzt. Du machst die Konsolidierungslogik nachvollziehbar und dokumentiert, statt sie im Kopf zu tragen – prüfungsfest, auch wenn du im Urlaub bist. Laufendes Rechnungswesen und Automatisierung Du steuerst das laufende Rechnungswesen über alle Gesellschaften und verantwortest Monats-, Quartals- und Jahresabschlüsse – termingerecht und ohne Feuerwehrübung vor der Prüfung. Du führst die Schnittstellen zu DATEV, Abschlussprüfung und externen Beratern so, dass Rückfragen selten und Antworten schnell sind. Externes Reporting und Bankenkommunikation Du verantwortest das Reporting an unsere Finanzierungspartner – Covenants, Kennzahlen, Berichtspflichten – und lieferst so, dass keine Nachfrage kommt. Du bereitest Zahlen für Adressaten auf, die eigene Interessen haben, und weißt, welche Aussage eine Zahl trägt und welche nicht. Du arbeitest in einem Umfeld, das hierarchisch in der Entscheidung, flach in der Kommunikation und autonom in der Ausführung ist. Leistung wird hier gefeiert, nicht versteckt – wer vorankommen will, weil er gut ist, findet den Raum dafür, ohne politische Tarnung und ohne Konsens-Theater. Deine Perspektiven Was du nach 6 Monaten geliefert hast: Du hast Konzernabschluss und Konsolidierungskreis vollständig übernommen und die Konsolidierungslogik so dokumentiert, dass sie nachvollziehbar ist. Das Reporting an unsere Finanzierungspartner läuft über deinen Tisch und ohne Rückfrage der Geschäftsführung durch. Was du nach 12 Monaten geliefert hast: Du hast mindestens einen Zukauf vollständig in den Konsolidierungskreis überführt – von der Eröffnungsbilanz bis zur laufenden Einbindung. Manuelle Vorgänge in Verbuchung, Abstimmung und Abschlussvorbereitung sind messbar zurückgegangen, weil du sie automatisiert hast. Die Jahresabschlussprüfung läuft ohne Feuerwehrübung – Arbeitspapiere und Nachweise liegen vor, bevor der Prüfer fragt. Die ausgewiesene Spanne ist kein Verhandlungsspielraum, sondern eine Profil-Skala: Das untere Ende steht für den Berufsträger frisch nach dem Examen, das obere für den, der Konzernabschlüsse bereits eigenständig verantwortet und die Methodik im eigenen Schwerpunkt geprägt hat. Wer einen anderen Hintergrund mitbringt, startet zu einem anderen Marktpreis und konvergiert nach zwölf Monaten bewährter Leistung auf das Rollen-Niveau – die Logik dahinter steht in unseren Vergütungsgrundsätzen. Repetitive Arbeit ist dir ein Reiz zur Automatisierung, kein Schicksal. Du erklärst einen Bilanzierungssachverhalt so, dass die Geschäftsführung die Konsequenz erkennt, ohne den Kommentar gelesen zu haben. Mindset & Persönlichkeit Du willst die Verantwortung für die Zahlen, nicht die Distanz des Testats. Du hast eine natürliche Abneigung gegen Ungenauigkeit – auf unzuverlässigen Zahlen werden keine zuverlässigen Entscheidungen getroffen. Du bringst die Demut mit, von Praktikern zu lernen. Der Buchhalter mit zwanzig Jahren Erfahrung weiß Dinge über den laufenden Betrieb, die in keinem Prüfungsprogramm stehen. Du bist bereit, fachlich allein zu stehen. Du bist in diesem Haus der Kopf für Bilanzierung – Sparring bekommst du von der Geschäftsführung und aus dem Prüfer-Netzwerk, aber niemand rechnet dir nach. Du hast den Anspruch, in allem, was du ablieferst, den höchsten Standard zu setzen – nicht weil jemand es kontrolliert, sondern weil Mittelmaß dich persönlich stört. Was du bei uns nicht finden wirst Kein Mandantengeschäft. Du betreust keine Mandate und baust keinen Mandantenstamm auf. Du verantwortest das eigene Rechnungswesen von Vogel. Wer Mandantenarbeit sucht, findet sie bei uns in anderen Rollen – hier nicht. Keine Personalverantwortung. „Lead" heißt hier fachliche Führung, nicht disziplinarische. Du wächst über Tiefe und Methodik, nicht über Personalspanne. Wer ein Team führen will, gehört in eine der Rollen auf der Führungslaufbahn. Kein Prüfungsmandat und keine Rotation. Du wechselst nicht mehr jährlich den Mandanten. Du baust ein Rechnungswesen über Jahre und lebst mit den Konsequenzen deiner eigenen Entscheidungen. Kein reines Buchhaltungs-Hinterzimmer. Du arbeitest sichtbar mit Geschäftsführung, Corporate Development und unserem Automatisierungs-Team. Was du lieferst, geht in Bankengespräche und Kaufentscheidungen. Kein Ausstieg aus der Prüfung in eine 45-Stunden-Woche. Die Intensität bleibt hoch – anders gerichtet, mit deutlich mehr Ownership, aber nicht weniger. FAQ 1. Was ist Vogel — und wo arbeitet ihr? Vogel ist eine der führenden Mittelstandsberatungen Deutschlands — Familienunternehmen seit 1959, aus Aalen — und baut daraus die führende Beratungsplattform für den Mittelstand. Wir wachsen an mehreren Standorten: in Aalen/Ostwürttemberg als gewachsenem Stammsitz und in München als neuem Hub. An beiden suchen wir quer durch die Funktionen — von Steuerberatung über Beratung bis zu den strategischen Teams, die die Plattform bauen. 2. Wie sind die Gehaltsbänder zu verstehen? Bewusst breit — und an jeder Stelle ausgewiesen. Wir differenzieren nach Track Record und Marktwert, nicht nach Abschluss: knappe, stark gefragte Profile am oberen Ende, weniger knappe am unteren. Wir kalibrieren ausschließlich am Markt — zwei Menschen mit ähnlicher Erfahrung können bei uns unterschiedlich verdienen. 3. Wie viel — und wie — wird bei Vogel gearbeitet? Gemessen wird an dem, was du bewegst, nicht an Stunden. Ehrlich ist aber auch: Wer 9-to-5 sucht, ist bei uns nicht die erste Adresse. Wir suchen Menschen, die aus eigenem Antrieb intensiv arbeiten, weil die Aufgaben es wert sind. Wie du deine Zeit verteilst, ist weitgehend deine Sache. Was wir teilen: Wir arbeiten präsent zusammen — Kultur, Sparring und die besten Ideen entstehen in der täglichen Nähe. Wir sind keine Remote-Company und haben keine großen Home-Office-Policies; einzelne Remote-Tage sind kein Problem. 4. Wie läuft die Bewerbung? Schlank, schnell, transparent — und nach Profil gestaffelt. Für Einstiegsrollen (Praktikum, Werkstudium, Berufseinstieg) genügen in der Regel zwei Gespräche und eine kurze Arbeitsprobe; erfahrene Rollen laufen etwas ausführlicher. Bei ausgewählten Senior-Rollen prüfen wir, künftig einen gemeinsamen Arbeitstag einzubauen, damit beide Seiten sich besser kennenlernen. Immer gilt: getaktete Termine, zügige Entscheidung, substanzielles Feedback — unabhängig vom Ausgang. 5. Wie funktioniert die variable Vergütung? Quartalsweise an Leistung gekoppelt, qualitativ bewertet. Die Skala steigt mit dem Level: bis 20 % Associate, 27,5 % Manager, 35 % Senior Manager, 42,5 % Director, 50 % VP. Erwartungswert bei guter Leistung — du erfüllst die Anforderungen, setzt eigene Akzente, bestehst den Keeper Test — liegt bei rund 50 % des Maximums; der Maximalbonus ist nicht der Normalfall. Im Fokus steht eine ganzheitliche Beurteilung durch deine Führungskraft: Ownership, Qualität, Lernkurve, Zusammenarbeit, Impact. 6. Wie entwickle ich mich — welche Karrierewege gibt es? Zwei aktive Wege: Mastery (fachliche Tiefe, Expertenlaufbahn) und Pioneer (Führung, Management). Die Richtung wählst du nach dem Onboarding, meist in Jahr 1–3. Berufseinstieg ist kein Sonderweg, sondern der frühe Teil derselben Strecke — vom Werkstudenten oder Praktikanten zum Associate, für die Besten ohne erneutes Bewerbungsverfahren. 7. Team, Kultur, Urlaub? Ein gemeinsames Mittagessen ist ein offenes tägliches Angebot — keine Pflicht; wer mag, kommt dazu, essen kann jeder jederzeit. Dazu Abendessen, Social Events und Offsites in regelmäßigem Rhythmus — nicht als Pflichtprogramm, sondern weil ein gutes Team auch abseits der Arbeit Zeit teilt. Benefits: durchdacht und substanziell, nicht symbolisch. Urlaub: 28 Tage. 8. Ich kenne jemanden — gibt es einen Empfehlungsbonus? Ja — 2.500 EUR für jede erfolgreich besetzte Stelle (keine Praktika). Kurzer Kontext reicht: an wen du denkst, für welche Rolle, warum. Muss nicht perfekt sitzen, aber substanziell sein. description: Role Description Dropbox is building the knowledge layer that connects content, context, and action. As AI moves from assistants to systems that act, the structure and stewardship of enterprise knowledge becomes the difference between AI that helps and AI that fails. This role owns the context layer our AI depends on: what it can know, what it can trust, and what it is allowed to act on. You will lead the central function, setting the strategy, architecture, standards, and operating model that make enterprise knowledge reliable, current, and permissions-aware for both human and AI use, while domain experts stay accountable for the accuracy of their content. AI capability changes quickly, and this role changes with it. What a model can interpret, how content needs to be structured for retrieval, and what a system can safely act on all shift as the technology moves. You will track those shifts, translate them into practical standards, and revise your own past decisions when the ground moves under them. This is the first role of its kind at Dropbox. You will partner with IT, Engineering, Legal, Privacy, and Security, and your decisions will show up directly in how AI performs across the company. Responsibilities Define the source-of-truth strategy for enterprise knowledge: which systems are authoritative, what is indexed centrally versus fetched live, what is eligible for AI use, and what is archived or excluded, informed by an assessment of the authoritative sources behind our highest-value workflows. Define the enterprise standards that make content AI-ready across structure, metadata, provenance, and access, including where semantic models or knowledge graphs are warranted and where they are not, and translate them into authoring patterns adopted across domains. Design the control model for AI actions, including eligibility rules, preconditions, approval boundaries, escalation paths, and rollback requirements, so systems that act on enterprise knowledge stay traceable and safe as AI capabilities evolve. Lead platform and connector strategy across the content stack. Drive decisions on what is refactored, migrated, indexed in place, or consolidated, and partner with IT and Engineering on connector architecture and how AI systems are granted access to tools and sources. Build the federated operating model for enterprise content: stewardship across functions, domains accountable for their own accuracy within shared standards, and lifecycle policies covering review cadence, expiration, material-change triggers, and retirement, tied to business criticality. Define content quality in an AI context. Stand up retrieval and grounding evaluations for priority use cases, extend measurement to workflow traces and policy conformance as systems begin to act, and route findings back into the content lifecycle. Co-own the criteria for AI content eligibility, sensitivity classification, and permissions modeling with Legal, Privacy, and Security, including access boundaries for the tools AI systems can reach. Requirements 7+ years designing how information is structured, owned, and maintained at enterprise scale, including at least 2 years applying that work to AI retrieval and grounding. Direct experience preparing content for AI consumption, with working fluency in retrieval-augmented generation, grounding, semantic chunking, embeddings, vector search, and citations. Hands-on experience with knowledge graphs, ontologies, or semantic models that structure content for machine consumption. Track record building federated operating models across functions outside direct reporting lines, with evidence of metadata standards or authoring frameworks adopted at scale. Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders across Engineering, IT, Legal, Security, and business functions. Sound judgment on balancing central standards with domain expertise. Preferred Qualifications Hands-on experience with enterprise platforms such as ServiceNow, Atlassian, Microsoft 365 or Copilot Search, Slack, or Notion. Familiarity with structured authoring(such as DITA), controlled vocabularies, or knowledge operations methodologies such as KCS. Experience with AI evaluation tooling and frameworks for measuring retrieval quality, groundedness, and answer relevance. Background working in regulated, policy-heavy, or high-risk content domains. Working knowledge of NIST AI RMF, OWASP GenAI guidance, or comparable risk frameworks. Durable Skills AI fluency means using these tools to amplify human judgment, not replace it. Judgment:Evaluate information and make decisions in complex situations. Adaptability:Learn, adjust, and stay effective through change. Connection:Communicate, collaborate, and build trust. This Engineer will work directly with teammates that are familiar with ontology formalisms and with domain experts who understand the operational realities of HCSC data. They will be expected to make and defend design decisions at the level of formal correctness, not just practical convenience, and to direct and evaluate LLM-assisted ontology discovery and enrichment pipelines with the rigor that formal alignment demands. Essential Duties: Design and maintain the ontology, covering the canonical structural layer (organizations, items, contracts, transaction), source data ontologies (supporting the canonical) and the process layer (data curation, ontology matching, workflows). Establish the rules for when two records from different systems refer to the same thing, and when they don't — recognizing the answer can differ by use case. Establish mappings from trading partner source data to the canonical ontology, with documented provenance and validity conditions for each mapping. Author OWL 2 axioms for ontology components; validate logical consistency (e.g. reasoner); maintain ontology lifecycle (e.g. with ROBOT, SHACL). Align with governance team and practice. Grounded ontology discovery from data (and its uses) rather than schema declarations and metadata alone. Collaborate with data quality engineers to establish formal feedback . Translate formal ontology design decisions into specification/implementation for graph and relational stores. Specify and implement SPARQL queries and graph schema requirements with sufficient precision to prevent implementation-level semantic loss. As AI moves from assistants to systems that act, the structure and stewardship of enterprise knowledge becomes the difference between AI that helps and AI that fails. AI capability changes quickly, and this role changes with it. What a model can interpret, how content needs to be structured for retrieval, and what a system can safely act on all shift as the technology moves. You will track those shifts, translate them into practical standards, and revise your own past decisions when the ground moves under them. This is the first role of its kind at Dropbox. You will partner with IT, Engineering, Legal, Privacy, and Security, and your decisions will show up directly in how AI performs across the company. Responsibilities Define the source-of-truth strategy for enterprise knowledge: which systems are authoritative, what is indexed centrally versus fetched live, what is eligible for AI use, and what is archived or excluded, informed by an assessment of the authoritative sources behind our highest-value workflows. Define the enterprise standards that make content AI-ready across structure, metadata, provenance, and access, including where semantic models or knowledge graphs are warranted and where they are not, and translate them into authoring patterns adopted across domains. Design the control model for AI actions, including eligibility rules, preconditions, approval boundaries, escalation paths, and rollback requirements, so systems that act on enterprise knowledge stay traceable and safe as AI capabilities evolve. Lead platform and connector strategy across the content stack. Drive decisions on what is refactored, migrated, indexed in place, or consolidated, and partner with IT and Engineering on connector architecture and how AI systems are granted access to tools and sources. Build the federated operating model for enterprise content: stewardship across functions, domains accountable for their own accuracy within shared standards, and lifecycle policies covering review cadence, expiration, material-change triggers, and retirement, tied to business criticality. Define content quality in an AI context. Stand up retrieval and grounding evaluations for priority use cases, extend measurement to workflow traces and policy conformance as systems begin to act, and route findings back into the content lifecycle. Co-own the criteria for AI content eligibility, sensitivity classification, and permissions modeling with Legal, Privacy, and Security, including access boundaries for the tools AI systems can reach. Requirements 7+ years designing how information is structured, owned, and maintained at enterprise scale, including at least 2 years applying that work to AI retrieval and grounding. Direct experience preparing content for AI consumption, with working fluency in retrieval-augmented generation, grounding, semantic chunking, embeddings, vector search, and citations. Hands-on experience with knowledge graphs, ontologies, or semantic models that structure content for machine consumption. Track record building federated operating models across functions outside direct reporting lines, with evidence of metadata standards or authoring frameworks adopted at scale. Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders across Engineering, IT, Legal, Security, and business functions. Sound judgment on balancing central standards with domain expertise. Preferred Qualifications Hands-on experience with enterprise platforms such as ServiceNow, Atlassian, Microsoft 365 or Copilot Search, Slack, or Notion. Familiarity with structured authoring(such as DITA), controlled vocabularies, or knowledge operations methodologies such as KCS. Experience with AI evaluation tooling and frameworks for measuring retrieval quality, groundedness, and answer relevance. Background working in regulated, policy-heavy, or high-risk content domains. Working knowledge of NIST AI RMF, OWASP GenAI guidance, or comparable risk frameworks. Durable Skills AI fluency means using these tools to amplify human judgment, not replace it. The Compute team at Temporal makes that durability feel effortless by building the managed compute primitives that run workers and other execution systems across Temporal Cloud. We’re solving a hard platform problem: make compute transparent, elastic, safe-by-default, observable, and multi-cloud — without turning customers into infrastructure operators. We build platform primitives that span a variety of execution environments (e.g., serverless-style runtimes, containerized fleets, and customer-controlled deployments). Our work sits at the intersection of control plane + data plane: scaling decisions, isolation boundaries, multi-tenant safety, and production-grade observability. Design self-optimizing autoscaling systems (signals, backstops, debouncing, guardrails) that scale worker fleets safely and predictably. Define the Open Source Server ↔ Cloud boundary for compute capabilities, keeping the architecture cohesive and maintainable. Own Architect, build, and operate services on the hot path of task execution where performance and correctness are customer-visible. Deliver real-world cloud integrations (e.g., customer-account execution): IAM boundaries, secure credentials handling, networking constraints, quotas, and failure modes. Make operability a feature: SLOs, tracing/metrics, load and failure testing, incident reviews, and continuous hardening. Ship end-to-end: API design, rollout strategy, backwards compatibility, and long-term maintenance. Teach Raise the bar through design docs, strong reviews, pragmatic technical leadership, and mentorship. Lead through influence across teams (Server, SDKs, Security, Control Plane) to land coherent platform changes. Strong systems fundamentals: concurrency, performance, reliability, and failure-mode thinking. Comfort owning outcomes: SLOs, incident response, and improving on-call quality over time. Excellent written communication and crisp tradeoff thinking. description: Job Requisition ID # 26WD94957 Position Overview At Autodesk, we are pioneers in 3D design, engineering, and entertainment software, building tools that empower some of the most creative minds on the planet to solve real-world problems. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Glassdoor, and others as a top place to work, we are dedicated to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where innovation and creativity thrive. Autodesk's Architecture, Engineering, and Construction (AEC) Data organization is seeking an experienced Software Architect to join the AEC Data team and define the cloud-native services and distributed-systems architecture that power the AEC Data Model (AECDM) and the many services around it. Data is the domain, but the role is fundamentally one of cloud and services architecture — APIs, service contracts, integrations, distributed-systems design, and the connected data model that ties them together — spanning multiple teams. It is not a data-warehouse or analytics-specialist role. The AEC Data organization is building the foundational data infrastructure behind Autodesk's vision for connected construction: the platforms, services, and unified data models that span the entire built-asset lifecycle, from design and construction through operation and maintenance. This work enables the continuous flow of AEC data (3D models, 2D drawings, issue tracking, cost, sensor streams, and more) across Autodesk products and third-party integrations. The architect will help shape the next generation of capabilities for the Autodesk Forma Industry Cloud, collaborating with software architects, domain experts, and product teams across Revit, Civil 3D, AutoCAD, Autodesk Construction Cloud, and Autodesk Forma. This is a senior individual-contributor role on an established architecture track, reporting to the Distinguished Architect of the AEC Data team, who also serves as the Lead Software Architect. The primary responsibility is to shape how multiple teams design and build — through standards, reference architectures, ADRs, and design-review governance — rather than to own a single service. The exact focus flexes to your strengths and organizational need. Responsibilities API Design & Evolution: Design and evolve API surfaces across the AEC Data services — resource modeling, addressing, versioning and backward-compatible evolution, query APIs, and unifying overlapping surfaces into a single coherent contract. System Architecture: Define and evolve cross-team, cloud-native architecture across the AEC Data services; design distributed systems including service contracts and event-driven flows. Schema Design & Evolution: Design, document, and evolve data schemas for AEC domain entities (buildings, infrastructure, spaces, systems, components, relationships) — including semantic models, property sets, classification systems, and relationship hierarchies. Own versioning, backward/forward compatibility, deprecation, and migration; maintain the schema registry, validation rules, and quality checks. Standards & Governance: Establish standards, reference architectures, and reusable components; author architecture proposals and decision records (ADRs) for review by a cross-org architecture council, and run cross-team design reviews. Prototyping & Feasibility: Evaluate alternative architectural directions through modeling and prototyping, de-risking key decisions before broad adoption. Mentorship & Technical Leadership: Mentor engineers and fellow architects on emerging and established technologies and on architectural practice; grow technical depth across teams. Reliability & Performance: Ensure reliability, security, and performance of systems; define SLOs and drive observability (metrics, tracing, logging). Communication: Communicate architecture with clear views and diagrams (e.g., C4) and executive-ready narratives; produce comprehensive documentation and onboarding materials. Minimum Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, or equivalent experience. 10+ years designing cloud-native, distributed systems, including 5+ years at cross-team architect altitude (Software Architect, Principal Engineer, Staff+, or equivalent). Title is flexible; scope of impact is the primary consideration. Deep expertise in cloud services (ideally AWS), API/service design, and distributed-systems patterns (microservices, event-driven, resilience). Solid grounding in data modeling and schema design — including schema definition languages (e.g., JSON Schema), versioning, and backward/forward-compatibility and evolution strategies — as applied both to standalone data schemas and to API contracts. Specialist data-warehouse or analytics architecture is not required. Excellent knowledge of software design and architecture patterns. Demonstrated ability to influence without authority and drive alignment across teams outside the candidate's direct management. Strong leadership and mentoring skills, with a track record of guiding and growing diverse, cross-functional teams. Mastery of conveying complex ideas concisely and persuasively, with excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills across a range of stakeholders. Ability to collaborate with a global team. Preferred Qualifications Preferred qualifications are a menu rather than a checklist: depth in a few core areas matters more than breadth across all of them. The emerging AI/ML capabilities below are advantageous and can be developed on the job; they are not prerequisites. Core: Cloud Services: AWS and its core services (EC2, ECS, Lambda, API Gateway, S3, DynamoDB, RDS). Distributed Systems: Domain-driven service decomposition, data consistency patterns (CQRS, event sourcing, sagas), and multi-tenant/multi-region design. API & Service Design: REST API design and evolution; GraphQL (including federation). Database Architecture: Relational and NoSQL (e.g., DynamoDB, PostgreSQL). Observability/SRE: OpenTelemetry, distributed tracing, metrics/SLOs for data services. Bonus: Semantic Technologies: Knowledge graphs, RDF/OWL, or property graphs — particularly relevant to the connected/semantic AECDM. BIM Expertise: Building Information Modeling concepts, Revit families, or similar parametric modeling systems. AI Systems: RAG, agents/MCP, agentic orchestration (LangGraph, Semantic Kernel), LLM observability, and data governance / AI safety (PII, prompt-injection, content filtering). Domain-Specific AI for AEC: BIM/IFC extraction, CAD or point-cloud processing. Event-Driven Architectures: Kafka or Kinesis; schema registries (Confluent, AWS Glue); exactly-once processing. AEC Domain Knowledge: Experience in the Architecture, Engineering, and Construction industry; familiarity with industry standards (IFC, COBie, gbXML, CityGML, LandXML, UniFormat, OmniClass). Domain onboarding is provided. About the Team The AEC Data team is building the AEC Data Model (AECDM) to enable better AECO (Architecture, Engineering, Construction, Operations) outcomes through more useful, connected, and accessible data. Its scope spans data services and APIs, product and design-tool integrations, and lifecycle/asset data across multiple teams — enabling the seamless flow of information across Autodesk products and third-party integrations so that AEC professionals can make better decisions with better data. Why Join Us Shape the future of AEC data platforms and standards at an industry-leading company. Design systems and schemas used by millions of architects, engineers, and construction professionals worldwide.
